label: UI combat — blocks owed on a confirmed attack
prompt: ui-gate `game-combat` surface (scripts/ui-gate/surfaces.ts, issue #3708, ADR 0132 §4). The BLOCK WINDOW: the opponent has declared and confirmed three attackers (CR 508.1) and the human seat owes the block declaration (CR 509.1), holding three untapped creatures and a trick in hand. This is the one declared position whose `activePlayer` is "opp" — deliberately, and it is what puts the HUMAN seat's own combat controls on screen: the block is a turn-based action owed to the DEFENDING player (CR 509.1a), so an attack by "me" would render the opponent's half of combat and measure nothing the viewer can act on. `priority` stays on the human seat, and `computeSoloViewerId` steers to the defender during this window regardless, so nothing the probe measures depends on the coin toss. Seed with: bunx convex run debugScenarios:seedScenarioDirect "$(cat scripts/ui-gate/combat-scenario.json)". Deployment-local by design (ADR 0044) — the lane seeds it at bootstrap.
